item.title: Show HN: Laurie, play chords from your laptop keyboard
item.summary: hi! my name is adhiv and I'm a electronic music producer + design engineer I made a website that let's you play and voice chords using your laptop keyboard! Designed for music producers who consider the computer their instrument of choice. You can play chords, change sounds, and export MIDI to your DAW live! I also built in a "strum" mode that let's you two finger swipe your trackpad to strum the notes of a chord you're holding down on Would love any thoughts or feedback :) launched this week!
